D.treatment: Zone Plan of rural school supervision

O.outcome_detail: results were reported as markedly superior, but the specific outcome is not stated

cells.quote: Reports the author's pioneer experiment with a "Zone Plan" of supervision of rural schools proved to give results markedly superior to those obtained in other representative, but unsupervised schools.
cells.note: No study text is available; the quoted sentence is from the wiki evidence entry.

O.outcome_detail: gains in abilities in school activities

cells.quote: "Results shown by (1) gains in abilities in school activities; (2) professional study of the teachers; (3) attendance, (4) effect on elimination of pupils from school; (5) social life of the community."
cells.note: No study text is available; this quote is from the wiki entry. The comparison, design, statistics, and direction are not stated.
